categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Everwin Precision Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: consumer electronics precision components and new energy product components. The consumer electronics segment includes electronic connectors, smart electronic product small parts, precision structural parts, and modules mainly used in laptops, wearables, smart home devices, smartphones, and e-books. The new energy segment focuses on battery structural parts, high-voltage electrical connectors, hydrogen fuel cell bipolar plates, and related components for new energy vehicles and energy storage systems. Additionally, the company is involved in robotics and industrial internet sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced precision manufacturing technologies including new materials such as titanium alloys, fiber-reinforced composites (glass fiber, carbon fiber), and high-performance polymers like silicone and rubber. It has developed innovative production processes such as slurry forging, cold heading, and automated CNC loading/unloading systems to improve efficiency and reduce costs. The firm also focuses on R&D in 3D printing, stainless steel hot forging, and laser welding for battery components, alongside proprietary technologies in connector design and manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading brands in consumer electronics such as smartphone and laptop manufacturers, as well as battery producers, module integrators, and automobile manufacturers in the new energy vehicle sector. The company serves industries including consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, energy storage, robotics, and industrial internet. Major end markets are global, with significant demand from China and international markets for smart terminals, AI-enabled devices, and electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Kunshan, Sichuan (Yibin and Zigong), Jiangsu (Changzhou), Fujian (Ningde), and other locations. It has expanded overseas with manufacturing facilities in Vietnam and Mexico and plans to establish production bases in Europe to meet global customer demands. The company’s sales are roughly split between domestic (about 53%) and international markets (about 47%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Everwin Precision Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and assembly of precision components and modules for electronic devices and new energy products. It supplies critical parts to downstream manufacturers such as device assemblers and battery pack integrators, playing a key role in the component supply chain for consumer electronics and new energy vehicles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include accelerating innovation in AI-enabled consumer electronics, expanding new energy vehicle component technologies, and enhancing manufacturing processes for cost reduction and quality improvement. R&D efforts focus on new materials (metal composites, high-strength polymers), advanced manufacturing techniques (3D printing, slurry forging, laser welding), and product development for AI smartphones, XR devices, and hydrogen fuel cells. The firm also emphasizes overseas production capacity expansion and digital transformation in production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of precision components and modules to major customers in consumer electronics and new energy sectors. The company’s income is based on product sales contracts, with customized and standard products supplied to clients. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue; the business model is product-centric with direct sales as the main revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Shenzhen Everwin Precision Technology positions itself as a leading precision component supplier in the consumer electronics and new energy vehicle industries. It emphasizes its technological innovation, broad product portfolio, and global manufacturing footprint to maintain competitive advantages. The company actively collaborates with top-tier brands and invests in R&D to sustain its market position amid intense competition and pricing pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 13.72 billion, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 85.7 million, showing profit growth despite a slight revenue decline. The new energy segment grew by over 43%, offsetting declines in consumer electronics. The company maintains significant R&D investment (~9% of revenue) and has expanded overseas production. Cash flow from operations improved substantially, reflecting operational resilience and growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced material applications (e.g., titanium alloys, composite fibers), and innovative production processes that enhance product quality and reduce costs. It offers customized solutions tailored to evolving customer needs in AI, XR, and new energy markets. Its global production network and strong R&D pipeline enable rapid response to market trends, providing customers with reliable, high-performance precision components critical for next-generation electronic and energy products.
